title: Crafti.ca - Theater Airship M.S. Prima Vista
author: jamsessionein

generated.description: A large floating theater airship built mostly from spruce, jungle, and oak planks with sandstone accents, shaped like a ship's hull with a raised stern and layered decks. At 71 by 81 by 145 blocks it is a very big build, with roughly 66,000 blocks. Its interior holds many functional details such as chests, furnaces, enchanting tables, a beacon, jukebox-style music blocks, and signs.
